rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl reads the isolated letters as signs: alif is God's ordering of things, lam His ancient gentleness, and mim His immense majesty.
rows.anchor: فالألف تأليف الله عز وجل ألف الأشياء كما شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sura openings are the Quran's secret because they are divine names and attributes; gathered in revealed sequence, their letters form the greatest name, الرحمن.
rows.anchor: وسر القرآن فواتح السور، لأنها أسماء وصفات

rows.speaker: ابن عباس والضحاك
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas and al-Dahhak interpret the initials as “I am God; I know.”
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عباس والضحاك: " الم " معناه: أنا الله أعلم

rows.speaker: علي رضي الله عنه
rows.claim: Ali says distinct letters gathered from the initials form a name of the All-Merciful; knowing and invoking it makes it the answering greatest name.
rows.anchor: وقال علي رضي الله عنه: هذه أسماء مقطعة، إذا أخذ من كل حرف حرف لا يشبه صاحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl assigns alif to God, lam to the servant, and mim to Muhammad, so the servant reaches his Lord through unifying Him and following the Prophet.
rows.anchor: الألف الله، واللام العبد، والميم محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas reads the letters as Allah, Gabriel, and Muhammad, an oath by all three that the Book revealed to Muhammad is from God.
rows.anchor: بلغني عن ابن عباس أنه قال: أقسم الله تعالى أن هذا الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl derives alif-lam-ha from God's greatest name and relates names of the Prophet and Adam to divine names, citing 28:30 and 47:11.
rows.anchor: إن الله تعالى اشتق من اسمه الأعظم الألف واللام والهاء، فقال:

words: ذلك بأن الله مولى الذين آمنوا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the cited verse, God is the believers' protector, while the unbelievers' protector is the tyrant, meaning Satan.
rows.anchor: ذلك بأن الله مولى الذين آمنوا وأن الكافرين لا مولى لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “There is no doubt in it” means there is no uncertainty in the Book.
rows.anchor: أي لا شك فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He glosses the Quran as clarification for the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: [2] أي بيانا للمتقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing disown any claim to independent power and take refuge in need of God's power in every state; God aids them, provides unexpectedly, and gives relief from trials.
rows.anchor: والمتقون هم الذين تبرؤوا من دعوى الحول والقوة دون الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's power is His action, which proceeds from His knowledge; His knowledge is an attribute of His essence. A servant's power is only a claim, since no moment belongs to anyone but God.
rows.anchor: قال سهل: حول الله وقوته فعله، وفعله بعلمه، وعلمه من صفات ذاته.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing believe in the unseen, disown power over commands and prohibitions in belief, speech, and action, and ask God for protection from sin and help to obey.
rows.anchor: أن يؤمنوا بالغيب وأن يتبرؤوا عن الحول والقوة فيما أمروا به ونهوا عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who profess faith only after seeing punishment gain nothing from that claim.
rows.anchor: فلم يك ينفعهم إيمانهم [غافر:85]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the arrival of punishment, their only confession is that they had been wrongdoers.
rows.anchor: فما كان دعواهم إذ جآءهم بأسنآ إلا أن قالوا إنا كنا ظالمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh claimed he would believe whenever he wished, but his belief was rejected once he finally professed it.
rows.anchor: فلما آمن لم يقبل منه، قال الله تعالى:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl glosses the word for rivals as opposites.
rows.anchor: قال سهل: أي أضدادا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greatest rival to God is the commanding soul, which pursues its desires and hopes without God's guidance.
rows.anchor: فأكبر الأضداد النفس الأمارة بالسوء المتطلعة إلى حظوظها ومناها بغير هدى من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Jews urged their foster brothers to obey God and follow the Prophet while failing to do so themselves.
rows.anchor: يعني اليهود كانوا يأمرون إخوانهم من الرضاعة بطاعة الله تعالى واتباع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Responding to God means supplicating; believing Him means affirming Him, for He is present when sincerely called without despair or loss of hope.
rows.anchor: أي يصدقوني، فأنا حيث ما دعاني مخلصا لا آيسا ولا قنطا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means someone intensely contentious in falsehood.
rows.anchor: أي شديد الخصومة بالباطل

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: Aisha reports the Prophet saying that the most hateful of men to God is the fiercely contentious adversary.
rows.anchor: روت عائشة رضي الله عنها عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Pride seized him through sin” means partisan zeal, as in 38:2, where the phrase means zeal and discord.
rows.anchor: يعني الحمية، كما قال في ص:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A soul's “capacity” means its strength or ability.
rows.anchor: أي طاقتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What the soul earns is the reward of its good deeds.
rows.anchor: لها ما كسبت } [286] أي ثواب العمل الصالح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What the soul acquires against itself is the burden of its sins.
rows.anchor: وعليها ما اكتسبت } [286] يعني أوزار الذنوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever is unconcerned about past sins will not be protected from sin later; without God's protection through the remaining days, one is lost in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: من لم تهمه الذنوب السالفة لم يعصم في أيامه الغابرة، ومن لم يعصمه الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person recognizes sins by guarding the heart's light and weighing everything allowed to enter or leave it.
rows.anchor: إذا حفظ أنوار قلبه فلم يترك شيئا يدخل عليه ولا يخرج منه، إلا بوزن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Opening a door to good brings seventy doors of divine enabling; opening one to evil brings seventy unseen doors of harm.
rows.anchor: من فتح على نفسه باب حسنة فتح الله عليه سبعين بابا من التوفيق، ومن فتح على نفسه باب سيئة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A heart occupied with what does not concern it is immediately punished by neglect of what does; only those who know God recognize this.
rows.anchor: وما من قلب يهم بما لا يعنيه إلا عوقب في الحال بتضييع ما يعنيه، ولا يعرف ذلك إلا العلماء بالله

words: نذرت لك ما في بطني محررا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's mother freed her child from worldly bondage, following caprice and the ego's desires, and dedicated her to serve the people of the Temple purely for God.
rows.anchor: أي حررته وأعتقته من رق الدنيا من متابعة هواه ومرادات نفسه، وجعلته خادما لعباد بيت المقدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God accepted Mary, for the Highest King is more entitled to one freed from the bondage of ego and worldly life.
rows.anchor: وقال: الملك الأعلى أولى بالمحرر عن رق النفس ورق الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Her good growth was righteous action through remembrance, bodily service to God, and the heart's knowledge of Him.
rows.anchor: بالعمل الصالح في ذكر الله تعالى وجوارحها في خدمة الله وقلبها في معرفة الله عز وجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God showed the Prophet the wisdom of the Quran and the laws of Islam by which to judge among people.
rows.anchor: يعني بما علمك الله تعالى من الحكمة في القرآن وشرائع الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's guardianship is His choice of whom He takes under His care; the Messenger is guardian of believers and must ally with those God and the believers ally with.
rows.anchor: قال: ولاية الله تعالى الاختيار لمن استولاه، ثم أعلم الرسول أنه ولي المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's party are victorious over the desires of their own souls.
rows.anchor: يعني غالبون هوى نفوسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whispering unfolds through natural disposition, then the soul, then inward concern and planning.
rows.anchor: الوسوسة ذكر الطبع، ثم النفس، ثم الهم والتدبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enemy's whisper has three stages: invitation, confidence once someone accepts, and finally waiting and hoping for an opening, as with the truthful.
rows.anchor: فالأول يدعوه ويوسوس له، والثاني يأمن إذا علم أنه يقبل، والثالث ليس له إلا الانتظار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seek inward sincerity of intention in private, since only the sincere recognize ostentation.
rows.anchor: اطلبوا من السر بالنية الإخلاص فإن الرياء لا يعرفه إلا المخلصون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Make outward action follow the Prophet; whoever does not follow him in every affair is astray, and other approaches are misleading.
rows.anchor: فإن من لم يكن اقتداؤه في جميع أموره بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فهو ضال،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgetting God means forgetting His blessings, so He makes them forget to give thanks for those blessings.
rows.anchor: يعني نسوا نعم الله عندهم، فأنساهم شكر النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Showing loyalty to fellow believers means refraining from harming them.
rows.anchor: موالاته مع المؤمنين كف الأذى عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A servant reaches the reality of faith by being like the earth to God's servants: they live on it and benefit from it.
rows.anchor: واعلموا أن العبد لا يبلغ حقيقة الإيمان حتى يكون لعباد الله كالأرض، إذ هم عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The seven foundations are adherence to God's Book, following His Messenger, lawful food, refraining from harm, avoiding sins, repentance, and fulfilling people's rights.
rows.anchor: الأصول عندنا سبع: التمسك بكتاب الله، والاقتداء برسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأكل الحلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who knows evil but does not avoid it is no scholar; likewise one who knows acts of obedience but does not perform them.
rows.anchor: كل عالم أعطي علم الشر، وليس هو مجانبا للشر، فليس بعالم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asked whom he should sit with, Sahl advised choosing someone whose actions, rather than speech, move you.
rows.anchor: سأل رجل سهلا فقال: يا أبا محمد، إلى من تأمرني أن أجلس إليه؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is the gnostics' adornment; they are at their best in service and servanthood, giving up what is theirs for what is due.
rows.anchor: العبادة زينة العارفين، وأحسن ما يكون العارف

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says Moses used to address Pharaoh as Abu Mus'ab and urge him to confess God's oneness and Moses' message.
rows.anchor: حكي عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنه أنه قال: كان موسى عليه السلام إذا دخل على فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God equipped Moses with patient restraint rather than rashness; the command to speak gently was not meant to predict Pharaoh's faith, but to teach Moses gracious speech that stirs hearts.
rows.anchor: إن الله تعالى ألبس موسى عليه السلام لبسة المتأوبين، ونفى عنه عجلة المتهجمين

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says hearts are disposed to love those who treat them well and hate those who mistreat them.
rows.anchor: كما قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: " جبلت القلوب على حب من أحسن إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gentle speech serves to establish Moses' proof and encourage the magicians and others whom God knows He will guide.
rows.anchor: ليقطع به حجته، ويرغب من علم الله هدايته من السحرة وغيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's being with Moses and Aaron means He watches and witnesses every state, granting power, help, and support; they need not fear delivering the message.
rows.anchor: أخبر الله أنه معهما بالنظر، مشاهد لكل حال هما عليه بالقوة والمعونة والتأييد، لا تخافا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eating from the tree is followed by a warning not to eat to fullness and become dulled to remembrance; such intoxication is forbidden.
rows.anchor: قوما ولا تشبعوا منه فتسكروا عن الذكر، فإن السكر حرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hunger reduces the blood and, in proportion, cuts off whispering from the heart; Sahl claims that even a madman would become sane by fasting himself.
rows.anchor: من جوع نفسه انتقص بقدر ذلك دمه، وبقدر ما انتقص من دمه بالجوع انقطعت الوسوسة من القلب

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: The Prophet says no container is more hateful to God than a belly filled with food.
rows.anchor: وقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: " ما من وعاء أبغض إلى الله من بطن ملئ طعاما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not look toward worldly delights that bring Satan's whispering, disobedience, the soul's hopes, or ease in familiar habits; each cuts one off from remembering God.
rows.anchor: أي لا تنظر إلى ما يورثك وسوسة الشيطان، ومخالفة الرحمن، وأماني النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prostration of the sun, moon, and other things is their knowledge of God expressed through humility and obedience.
rows.anchor: سجود هذه الأشياء معرفتها بالحق بالتذلل والانقياد له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No prophet or messenger was unjust; the warning about wrongdoing indirectly addresses their communities, as does the warning to Muhammad in 39:65, making his community more cautious.
rows.anchor: لم يكن في الأنبياء والرسل ظالم، وإنما هذه مخاطبة لهم كناية عن قومهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's household took Moses in expecting joy and delight, unaware that divine power had destined him to become their enemy and grief.
rows.anchor: أي رفعوه ليكون لهم فرحا وسرورا ولم يعلموا، إنما أضمرت القدرة فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rejoicing in something unworthy of joy brings unending grief; a believer has no rest before meeting God.
rows.anchor: من فرح بغير مفروح استجلب حزنا لا انقطاع له، وليس للمؤمن راحة

rows.speaker: الأعمش
rows.claim: Al-A'mash recalls attending a funeral where everyone was so grieved that they did not know whom to console.
rows.anchor: حكي عن الأعمش قال: كنا نشهد جنازة فلا ندري من نعزي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one prospers by gazing at himself or succeeds by claiming a spiritual state for himself.
rows.anchor: ما نظر إلى نفسه أحد فأفلح، ولا ادعى لنفسه حالا فتم له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fortunate turn from their own states and deeds to God's favor in every action; the wretched boast of their own qualities and deeds, inviting ruin.
rows.anchor: والسعيد من الخلق من صرف بصره عن أحواله، وأفعاله سبيل الفضل والإفضال،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl understands Qarun's claim as a claim to merit: Qarun was the best reader of the Torah, and God visibly sank him.
rows.anchor: يعني الفضل، وهو أنه كان أقرأهم للتوراة، فادعى لنفسه فضلا، فخسف الله به الأرض ظاهرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person's inward sinking is loss of divine protection, inflated claims of power, blindness to God's favor, and failure to give thanks; this signals decline.
rows.anchor: وخسف الأشرار هو منع العصمة، والرد إلى الحول والقوة بإطلاق اللسان في الدعاوي العريضة،

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seek provision through trust in God, not earning; seeking it by earning is the way of ordinary people.
rows.anchor: اطلبوا الرزق بالتوكل لا بالكسب، فإن طلب الرزق بالكسب طريق العوام

rows.speaker: عيسى بن مريم
rows.claim: Jesus says people truly desire neither this world nor the next: obedience to the Lord of either would bring it, but they obey neither.
rows.anchor: حكي عن عيسى بن مريم عليه السلام أنه قال: بحق أقول لكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincerity in prayer beautifies turning away from indecency; a prayer that does not restrain evil and lacks this effect is defective and must be purified.
rows.anchor: في هذه الآية تزيين الانصراف عن الفحشاء والمنكر بواحدة وهو الإخلاص في الصلاة، وكل صلاة لا تنهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created people as needy before Him while He is rich; claiming self-sufficiency veils one from God, while manifesting need joins one's poverty to His wealth.
rows.anchor: فمن ادعى الغنى حجب عن الله عز وجل، ومن أظهر فقره إليه أوصل الله فقره بغناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant should inwardly need God and sever dependence on all else for pure servanthood, whose essence is abasement and humility.
rows.anchor: ينبغي للعبد أن يكون مفتقرا إليه في السر، منقطعا عن غيره، حتى تكون عبوديته محضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True need is shown through primordial need, present need, and the death of the self's own management; otherwise the claimed poverty is false.
rows.anchor: قال: إظهار الفقر في ثلاث: فقرهم القديم، وفقرهم في حالهم، وفقرهم في موت أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The truthful poor person neither asks, refuses, nor withholds.
rows.anchor: الفقير الصادق الذي لا يسأل ولا يرد ولا يحبس

rows.speaker: عمر بن عبد العزيز
rows.claim: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz describes God's friends by trust in Him in everything, need of Him in everything, and return to Him from everything.
rows.anchor: وقال عمر بن عبد العزيز رضي الله عنه: صفة أولياء الله عز وجل ثلاثة أشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbelievers' persistence with their idols is blameworthy patience: remaining in disobedience.
rows.anchor: هو الصبر المذموم الذي وبخ الله به الكفار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl distinguishes patience in obedience, in pain, in suffering, and blameworthy persistence in disobedience.
rows.anchor: وقد سمعته يقول: الصبر على أربع مقامات: صبر على الطاعة، وصبر على الألم، وصبر على التألم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet never strayed from the reality of divine oneness and never followed Satan.
rows.anchor: أي ما ضل عن حقيقة التوحيد قط، ولا اتبع الشيطان بحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl says the vision occurred at the beginning, when God created him.
rows.anchor: يعني في الابتداء حين خلقه الله سبحانه وتعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account describes him as a light in a column of light a million years before creation, with faith's innate qualities, unveiling the unseen through the unseen and worshipping before God.
rows.anchor: ويقال نورا في عامود النور قبل بدء الخلق بألف ألف عام بطبائع الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Lote Tree of the Boundary is the tree at which everyone's knowledge ends.
rows.anchor: وهي شجرة ينتهي إليها علم كل أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gaze did not turn toward the self or its own witnessing; wholly absorbed in its Lord, it witnessed the attributes manifested to it that secured its steadiness there.
rows.anchor: ما مال إلى شواهد نفسه ولا إلى مشاهدتها، وإنما كان مشاهدا بكليته ربه تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person will see that their striving is unfit for God and learn what it merits; without God's grace, that striving would perish.
rows.anchor: سوف يرى سعيه ويعلم أنه لا يصلح للحق ويعلم الذي يستحقه سعيه، وأنه لو لم يلحقه فضل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The outward sense concerns worldly provision; inwardly, God enriches through obedience and makes poor through disobedience.
rows.anchor: ظاهرها متاع الدنيا، وباطنها أغنى بالطاعة وأفقر بالمعصية

rows.speaker: ابن عيينة
rows.claim: Ibn Uyayna explains the words as making someone content and satisfied.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عيينة: أغنى وأقنى أي أقنع وأرضى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Prophet's time the moon split into two pieces, one of which went behind Mount Hira.
rows.anchor: على عهد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فلقتين، حتى ذهبت فلقة وراء جبل حراء

rows.speaker: حذيفة بن اليمان
rows.claim: In a sermon, Hudhayfa says the Hour is near, the world has turned away, and this life is the training ground before tomorrow's race; those who work today will win in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: فقام حذيفة بن اليمان على المنبر، فحمد الله وأثنى عليه، ثم قال:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught Adam speech arising from spirit, rational understanding, heart discernment, human thought, and natural disposition, then clarified it.
rows.anchor: يعني علمه الكلام الذي هو من نفس الروح وفهم العقل وفطنة القلب وذهن الخلق وعلم نفس الطبع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The foremost are those whom God chose and granted guardianship before their existence.
rows.anchor: هم الذين سبق لهم من الله الاختيار والولاية قبل كونهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The brought-near occupy stations of closeness and intimacy; they were foremost in worldly faith: prophets in God, and the truthful and martyrs among the Companions and others in the prophets.
rows.anchor: في منازل القرب وروح الأنس، وهم الذين سبقوا في الدنيا، فسبق الأنبياء إلى الإيمان بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Protect yourselves and your families from the Fire through obedience to God and following the Prophetic practice.
rows.anchor: يعني بطاعة الله واتباع السنن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nun is a name of God; joined to the initial letters alif-lam-ra and ha-mim, it forms the name الرحمن.
rows.anchor: النون اسم من أسماء الله تعالى، إذا جمعت بين أوائل السور:

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets nun as the inkwell from which the remembrance was written, and the pen as that which wrote the wise remembrance.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: النون الدواة التي كتب الذكر منها، والقلم الذي كتب به الذكر الحكيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “What they write” is what the recording angels write of the deeds of Adam's children.
rows.anchor: ما تكتبه الحفظة من أعمال بني آدم

rows.speaker: عمر بن واصل
rows.claim: Umar ibn Wasil says this is the writing God undertakes for His servants, containing benefits and welfare for people and lands.
rows.anchor: وقال عمر بن واصل: وما يسطرون، أي: وما تولى الله لعباده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's character followed the Quran and never crossed its limits, including God's command to justice and excellence in 16:90.
rows.anchor: تأدبت بأدب القرآن، فلم تتجاوز حدوده وهو قوله تعالى:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anger and harshness arise from relying on one's own strength; leaving that reliance allows inner weakness to produce mercy and gentleness, embodying God's qualities.
rows.anchor: إن الغضب والحدة من سكون العبد إلى قوته، فإذا خرج من سكونه إلى قوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's gentleness toward people is also exemplified in 3:159.
rows.anchor: وقال: فبما رحمة من الله لنت لهم

rows.speaker: الله
rows.claim: God tells David to take on His qualities, saying that He is patient.
rows.anchor: وقد أوحى الله تعالى إلى داود عليه السلام فقال: " تخلق بأخلاقي فإني أنا الصبور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good character is the greatest spiritual station: lesser stations connect with ordinary people, while noble character connects with divine attributes.
rows.anchor: فمن أوتي الخلق الحسن فقد أوتي أعظم المقامات، لأن ما دونه من المقامات ارتباط بالعامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl calls changing a blameworthy trait into a praiseworthy one the greatest spiritual gift; other marvels soon pass.
rows.anchor: ولكن أكبر الكرامات أن تبدل خلقا مذموما من أخلاقك بخلق محمود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The left-handed person's record contains evil deeds and disbelief, so he wishes he had never been resurrected.
rows.anchor: أي بما فيه من الأعمال الخبيثة والكفر، فيتمنى أن يكون غير مبعوث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His abundant wealth did not help because he paid none of God's due from it and did not maintain kinship.
rows.anchor: كثرة مالي، حيث لم أؤد منه حق الله، ولم أصل به القرابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His lost authority means his argument and excuse.
rows.anchor: يعني حجتي وعذري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At God's command, one hundred thousand angels rush to seize him; an angel could grasp the whole earth with its mountains and seas, then his hands are bound to his neck and he is cast into Hell.
rows.anchor: فإذا قال ذلك ابتدره مائة ألف ملك، لو أن ملكا منهم أخذ الدنيا بما فيها من جبالها وبحارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nine jinn from Nasibin in Yemen came upon Muhammad reciting in prayer; the term نفر denotes three to ten, and these leading members of their people believed and returned as warners.
rows.anchor: قال: كان تسعة نفر من نصيبين اليمن، والنفر اسم يقع على الثلاثة إلى العشرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran's guidance to right direction means directing people to follow the Chosen Prophet's way.
rows.anchor: يعني يدل على اتباع سنن المصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl recounts visiting an ancient city of Aad, where he entered a carved-stone palace and saw a giant in prayer toward the Kaaba, wearing a fresh-looking wool robe.
rows.anchor: قال سهل: رأيت في دار عاد الأولى مدينة مبنية من حجر، فيها قصر عظيم منقور من حجر يأويه الجن

rows.speaker: الجني
rows.claim: The jinn worshipper says the robe has lasted nine hundred years, during which he met Jesus and Muhammad and believed in them; unlawful food and persistent sins wear out bodies and clothing.
rows.anchor: فقال: وعليك السلام يا أبا محمد، عجبت لطراوة جبتي وهي علي منذ تسعمائة سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sahl reports that Paradise has wild tracts where jinn live, eat, and drink, citing 55:74 as evidence.
rows.anchor: بلغني أن في الجنة براري يسكنها الجن، ويأكلون فيها ويشربون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not call on a partner with God: none can prevent His servants from remembering Him, and what belongs to God cannot be barred or restrained by anyone.
rows.anchor: أي لا تدعوا مع الله شريكا، أي ليس لأحد معي شريك في شيء يمنع عبادي من ذكري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person given extended wealth is al-Walid ibn al-Mughira; what God extended to him was greed and long expectation.
rows.anchor: يعني الوليد بن المغيرة، جعلت له الحرص وطول الأمل
